title: docs: fix stale current-review routing in contribution index
head: d9a651686fd9ba0745920f76a71d154f51ccd570
body:
Readers following CONTRIBUTING.md's contribution-review link are directed to the historical #531 review as the “current checkpoint,” and to the October 11 research integration as the “latest” batch. The selected record instead resolves to the #1094 review.

This changes only the introductory routing in `docs/research/contribution-review.md`: follow the selected record's `review`, `source_manifest`, `certificate`, and `reproduce` fields; use the PR ledger for dispositions; keep the existing #531 and October 11 links explicitly historical. The historical body, source artifacts, attribution, and selected frontier are unchanged. No new mathematical result or κ is claimed.

### Task and overlap

- Card: `scope-navigation`, consolidation; scope key `b18e0e173a4430a9564b`, refined to this one onboarding route.
- Allocation nonce: `94ac6e7e91dbc27dc086c41e1aa44e94`; priority revision 2.
- Base: current main `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8`.
- Selected-record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- PR #1232 at `1a0ecf7f534a67a910b7b5a7e0abe46be074c609` already addresses historical headings in current-status.md. That initial candidate was discarded; this is a separate file and incoming CONTRIBUTING link.
- Refreshed `python3 scripts/find_overlap.py 'contribution-review.md' 'direct-delivery review' --refresh`: no literal matches across 871 open PRs (including drafts), 30 discussion records, and the helper's local notes/ledger coverage, at 2026-10-13 21:43 UTC. Pagination complete; arbitrary diffs and nested sources are not searched, so this is not a novelty proof.

### Validation

- `python3 -B scripts/research_baseline.py`: `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.
- `git diff --check`: pass.
- A standard-library check resolved every introductory local link and the selected record's three file targets, checked the four field names, and compared the entire historical suffix beginning `The selected PR #39 chain` byte-for-byte against the base: pass.
- Verified that the diff touches only this one Markdown file. No persistent test added for this documentation-only repair; no cold supplier replay or mathematical verification claimed.

Credit Douglas Colkitt's existing contribution index and review lineage, and the adjacent navigation work in #1232. Prepared for Arham Tahir with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
